# The Mountaineers

> > A Pacific Northwest outdoor education and recreation organization offering alpine climbing, glacier climbing, and mountaineering courses in the North Cascades, Olympics, and surrounding mountain ranges.

The Mountaineers is a Seattle-based organization that provides guided climbing activities, mentored climbs, and outdoor education throughout Washington State's premier mountain ranges. Activities range from basic alpine climbs to technical glacier routes on peaks like Eldorado, Mount Washington, and White Chuck Mountain.

## Key Topics

- Basic Alpine Climbing
- Glacier Climbing
- The Ten Essentials
- North Cascades National Park
- Eldorado Peak
- Inspiration Glacier
- Mount Washington (Olympics)
- Seattle Climbing Committee
- Tacoma Branch
- Mentored Climbs
- Olympic Mountains
- Mountaineering Equipment
- Standard Route Climbs
- One-Day Climbs
- Grade II Climbing

## North Cascades Climbing Activities

- [Basic Alpine Climb - Eldorado Peak/Inspiration Glacier](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/activities/basic-alpine-climb-eldorado-peak-inspiration-glacier-7): One-day climb: Eldorado Peak via Inspiration Glacier, North Cascades
- [Basic Glacier Climb - Eldorado Peak/Inspiration Glacier](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/activities/glacier-climb-eldorado-peak-inspiration-glacier-14): Overnight glacier climb: Eldorado Peak via Inspiration Glacier, Cascade Pass
- [Basic Alpine Climb - Mount Logan/Douglas Glacier](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/activities/basic-alpine-climb-mount-logan-douglas-glacier): Multi-day Grade II climb: Mount Logan via Douglas Glacier, North Cascades
- [Basic Alpine Climb - White Chuck Mountain/Northwest Route](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/activities/basic-alpine-climb-white-chuck-mountain-northwest-route-1): Basic alpine climb: White Chuck Mountain Northwest Route with Seattle group

## Olympic Mountains Climbing Activities

- [Basic Alpine Climb - Mount Washington/Standard Route](https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/activities/basic-alpine-climb-mount-washington-standard-route-2): Basic alpine climb activity: Mount Washington via Standard Route in Olympics

## Community & Support

- [General Feedback & Ideas](https://feedback.mountaineers.org/): Community feedback platform for course management and registration ideas
